description: This file defines the SwfClient class for interacting with Amazon Simple Workflow Service (SWF) in PHP. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for each API operation, distinguishing it within the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: SwfClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with Amazon SWF, extending the base AWS client with additional methods specific to SWF operations.
